title: Coating of plates with Geltrex for human iPSC culture
author: Ralitsa R Madsen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.utcewiw
materials: 4 °C Thaw one tube of Geltrex (1-5 mL) slowly at 2-8°C. Prepare 20X 1.5 ml Eppendorfs for aliquotting of Geltrex, label: 50X Mix Geltrex by slowly pipetting solution up and down; be careful not to introduce air bubbles. On ice: in a 15 ml Falcon tube, mix Geltrex 1:1 with cold DMEM/F12 (Sigma #D6421) and aliquot at 0.5 ml. Store the aliquots at -20C. (REMEMBER TO CHECK EXPIRY DATE ON EVERYTHING)

steps.title: Label plates for coating
steps.instruction: Identify all plates or dishes that will be coated and label them clearly.

steps.title: Thaw Geltrex/DMEM‑F12 on ice
steps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot of the 1:1 Geltrex/DMEM‑F12 mixture on ice.

steps.title: Prepare cold DMEM/F12 aliquot
steps.instruction: Aliquot 22 mL of cold DMEM/F12 and keep it on ice (≈4 °C).

steps.title: Dilute Geltrex to 1:100
steps.instruction: On ice, add 450 µL of the 1:1 Geltrex (50X) to the 22 mL cold DMEM/F12 to obtain a final dilution of 1:100 (≈1:50 dilution of the 1:1 stock). Adjust volumes empirically if a different coating concentration is required.

steps.title: Apply diluted Geltrex to surfaces
steps.instruction: Add enough diluted Geltrex solution to completely cover each growth surface:

substeps.instruction: 100 µL per well of a 96‑well plate
0.5 mL per well of a 24‑well plate or 4‑well Ibidi imaging dish

steps.title: Incubate coating at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the coated plates/dishes in a 37 °C incubator for 60 minutes; sealing the container is not required.

steps.title: Equilibrate plates to room temperature
steps.instruction: After incubation, remove the plates that will be used for cell seeding and let them sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before plating.

steps.title: Store unused coated plates
steps.instruction: Seal remaining coated plates with parafilm and store them at 2 – 8 °C (preferably ≤1 week, but up to 2 weeks is acceptable). Ensure the coated surface never dries out to prevent premature gelling.

steps.title: Aspirate coating and seed cells
steps.instruction: Immediately before cell seeding, aspirate the Geltrex coating from the surface and add cells suspended in pre‑equilibrated cell‑culture medium; do not rinse the surface.
